outline.heading: Tokens: how the model sees text

points.text: The model doesn't read letters or words.
Each token number turns into an embedding — a long vector of numbers.
The core mechanism of modern models is described in the paper "Attention Is All You Need" (Vaswani et al., 2017).
The model learns one task: predict the next token from the previous ones.

outline.heading: Why the model knows — and why it lies

points.text: To continue text well, it pays for the model to capture the regularities of the world: grammar, facts, styles of reasoning.
